title: Introduce cost-driver chronicle and interactive alert-tuning wizard
author: Leila Martinez
description:
Motivation: Customers need a clearer, time-ordered view of how token-level costs evolve across an invocation (a 'chronicle') so SREs and product engineers can pinpoint cost drivers by path and prompt-shape. This PR adds a lightweight cost-driver chronicle data pipeline, a new chronicle dashboard with step-by-step cost journey sparklines, and an interactive alert-tuning wizard that suggests tuned thresholds based on historical chronicle patterns.

What this implements: 1) Invocation chronicle proto and ingestion hook: incremental cron-based rollups that stitch token cost by phase (prefetch, encode, attention, kv, decode) with compact histograms keyed by route and model-version. 2) Chronicle indexer: an on-write index that produces per-route time-ordered "cost journey" rows for quick lookup. 3) Chronicle dashboard: a Grafana panel and a small frontend widget (console) that renders a per-invocation sparkline, phase breakdown, and top-3 cost contributors. 4) Alert-tuning wizard: a server-side calibration job plus Console flow that recommends alert bands (median + x * MAD) and a suggested quieting policy for noisy routes. 5) Small API: /observability/chronicles and /observability/chronicles/estimate endpoints for retrieval and simulated alert calibrations.

Non-goals: this PR does not change the token billing tables, nor it does full-fidelity trace storage. Chronicle rows are deliberately compact and sampled to control cardinality.

Checklist: - [x] Schema and migration for chronicle rows (compact histograms) - [x] Indexer and ingestion hook implemented with backpressure safeguards - [x] Basic query API and pagination - [x] Console widget and Grafana panel - [x] Alert-tuning backend and Console flow - [x] Unit + integration tests for indexer and API - [x] Load test (small-scale synthetic replay) and performance microbenchmarks

Rollout plan: 1) Feature gated by org flag (observability:chronicle) 2) Canary ingestion enabled for 5% of routes for 48h 3) Observe retention, cardinality, and latency; increase to 25% then 100% if metrics stable 4) Enable alert-tuning wizard in Console behind a role-based gate for SRE/Power users.

Backward compatibility: The chronicle ingestion uses new tables and does not affect existing SLO pipelines. API adds new endpoints but does not modify existing contract endpoints.

Testing notes: Synthetic-replay harness added under benchmark-lab/chronicle-replay to validate indexer under bursty traffic. Local dev: run ./scripts/chronicle/ingest-local.sh to seed test rows.

Related linear/jira: ENG-3245 (cost chronicle), ENG-3301 (alert tuning), SUP-1120 (customer support request for long-tail cost attribution).

release_notes: Added 'cost chronicle' ingestion and dashboard to visualize token-level cost journeys; introduced an interactive alert-tuning wizard that recommends thresholds from historical chronicle data. Feature gated and rolled out via canary. Requires observability:chronicle flag to enable.
runtime_impact_summary: Indexer runs as a bounded worker group with backpressure and per-tenant TTL; expected <5% CPU overhead on observability tier during canary. Added two metrics to monitor: indexer_backlog and indexer_discard_count.
